node.statement: Every eta with 0 <= eta <= rho_fac lies simultaneously in the domains of lem-routef-degree-two-estimate, lem-routef-delta-upsilon-telescope, lem-routef-multiplicative-telescope, and lem-routef-upsilon-delta-telescope; hence rho_fac is a common domain for the degree-two estimate and the three Route-F factorization estimates.
